newsitem.headline: Horace Mann Educators Corp Q4 oper net up.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Income from continuing operations is before realized investment gains and losses, debt retirement costs and additional rights relating to share repurchase, after tax.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Excluding a non-cash charge for amortization of intangible assets, operating income per share was $0.98 (diluted) for the 1996 Q4 vs $0.86, and $3.42 for the year (diluted) vs $2.91.
Net income was $15.8 million or $0.67/shr vs $21.5 million or $0.84/shr for the Q4. Net income for the year was $64.6 million in 1996 vs $74.0 million, representing $2.75/shr for both periods.
Revenues totaled $180.1 million vs $176.5 million in the Q4 and $703.8 million vs $692.4 million for the full year.
